description: Long-term (positions intended to be held months). Daily bars only. Buys any of the 200 stocks that is currently a leader - above a rising 200-day EMA, above the 50-day SMA, 6-month ROC > 10%, within 15% of its 250-day high - and is not extended above its 20-day EMA. Holds through all normal pullbacks; sells only when price is below the 200-day EMA while the 50-day SMA is falling, or on a wide 8xATR disaster stop.

transitions.when: close > ema(200) and ema(200) > ema(200)[20] and close > sma(50) and roc(120) > 10 and close > donchian.upper(250) * 0.85 and close < ema(20) * 1.10

hypothesis: 5-7% a month (80-125% a year) is not reachable by this idea and I do not claim it: holding these stocks averaged +1.9%/month and no daily long-only rule measured here has beaten that. The honest target is +2.5-3.5%/month with the dip under 30%. Every prior version failed the same way - too idle (75-90% flat) or cutting compounders. This one inverts that: the entry is a standing state, not an event, so the ten slots refill the day one empties and stay ~100% used, occupied by leaders rather than random names; the exit is deliberately severe so compounders are held for years and fees are ~2 trades/stock/year. Excess over hold must come from slot selection plus sitting out confirmed bear regimes (2018, 2020, 2022).
